description: MeSticker MVP — Photo to cartoon sticker web app with AI generation, Stripe payments, and Printful fulfillment

userStories.title: Install shadcn components and set up base layout
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core UI component library installed and a responsive mobile-first layout shell so that all subsequent features have a consistent foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Install shadcn/ui components: button, card, dialog, input, select, badge, progress, skeleton, sheet, separator, label
Create a base layout in src/app/page.tsx with a centered container max-w-md for mobile-first design
Add the 3-step progress indicator component at src/components/progress-steps.tsx showing Capture → Style → Order steps
The progress indicator accepts a currentStep prop of type AppStep and highlights the active step with the primary color (#6C63FF)
Page renders with the progress indicator and a placeholder for each step
Typecheck passes
Build passes

userStories.title: Camera capture component with photo upload
userStories.description: As a user, I want to take a photo with my camera or upload one from my gallery so that I can turn it into a sticker.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/camera-capture.tsx component
Component shows a live camera viewfinder using getUserMedia API with a preference for the user-facing (selfie) camera
Large circular shutter button at the bottom center to capture a photo
Gallery/upload button at the bottom-left that opens a file picker for existing photos (accept image/jpeg, image/png)
Camera toggle button (front/back) at the bottom-right using the Lucide SwitchCamera icon
After capture or upload, show a preview of the photo with 'Use This Photo' and 'Retake' buttons
Component calls an onPhotoSelected(imageDataUrl: string) callback with the captured/uploaded image as a data URL
Graceful fallback if camera access is denied — show only the upload button with a message
Typecheck passes
Build passes

userStories.title: Style preset data and swipeable carousel
userStories.description: As a user, I want to browse different cartoon styles by swiping through a carousel so that I can pick the style I like best.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/presets.ts with an array of StylePreset objects for these styles: Spongebob, Family Guy, The Simpsons, Rick and Morty, Hey Arnold, Renaissance Painting, Anime
Each preset has: id, name, description, previewImage path (pointing to /presets/{id}.png), and a detailed prompt string for image generation
The prompts should instruct the AI to transform the person in the photo into that specific art style while preserving their likeness, pose, and expression
Create src/components/style-carousel.tsx with a horizontal swipeable carousel of style cards
Use Framer Motion for smooth drag/swipe physics with spring animations
Each card shows the style name, a brief description, and a colored placeholder (since we don't have preview images yet — use a gradient background with an emoji or Lucide icon as placeholder)
Tapping a card selects it (highlighted border + checkmark badge)
Selected style is passed via onStyleSelected(preset: StylePreset) callback
A 'Create My Sticker' button appears below the carousel when a style is selected
Carousel is touch-friendly with momentum scrolling
Typecheck passes
Build passes

userStories.title: Main page flow with step-by-step navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to move through the app step by step (Capture → Style → Order) on a single page so that the experience feels smooth and guided.
acceptanceCriteria: Refactor src/app/page.tsx into a stateful single-page app with step management
Use React state to track: currentStep (AppStep), capturedImage (string | null), selectedStyle (StylePreset | null), generatedImage (string | null)
Step 1 (Capture): Shows CameraCapture component. On photo selected, advances to Step 2

Step 2 (Style): Shows the captured photo at the top (small preview) + StyleCarousel below. On 'Create My Sticker' click, triggers generation (placeholder for now — just show a loading state then advance to Step 3)
Step 3 (Order): Shows placeholder order screen with the generated image
Use Framer Motion AnimatePresence for smooth transitions between steps (fade + slide up)
Progress indicator updates to reflect current step
User can tap completed steps in the progress indicator to go back
Typecheck passes
Build passes

userStories.title: Loading state component with playful animations
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a fun animated loading screen while my sticker is being generated so that the wait feels magical rather than boring.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/loading-state.tsx component
Shows a pulsing/animated container with the user's original photo gently bouncing or rotating
Cycles through playful messages like: 'Sprinkling cartoon dust...', 'Drawing your features...', 'Adding the finishing touches...', 'Almost there...'
Messages rotate every 2-3 seconds with a fade transition (Framer Motion)
A subtle progress indicator (animated dots or a shimmer bar) shows activity
Component accepts a styleName prop to personalize messages (e.g., 'Entering the Simpsons universe...')

userStories.title: Remove.bg background removal integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a server-side function to remove the background from a user's photo so that the generated sticker has a clean transparent background.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/removebg.ts with a removeBackground(imageBase64: string) function
Function sends the base64-encoded image to the remove.bg API (https://api.remove.bg/v1.0/removebg)
Sends image as base64 in the request body with 'image_file_b64' field, format 'png', size 'auto'
Returns the result as a base64-encoded PNG string
Uses REMOVEBG_API_KEY from environment variables
Handles API errors gracefully with descriptive error messages
Typecheck passes
Build passes

userStories.title: Gemini image generation integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a server-side function to transform a photo into a specific cartoon style using the Gemini API so that users get their styled sticker image.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/gemini.ts with a generateStyledImage(imageBase64: string, prompt: string) function
Uses the @google/genai package to call the Gemini API
Uses the 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp' model (or latest image-generation-capable model) with responseModalities including 'image'
Sends the user's photo (as inline base64 data) along with the style prompt
The prompt instructs Gemini to transform the person into the specified art style while preserving likeness
Extracts the generated image from response.candidates[0].content.parts, finding the part with inlineData
Returns the generated image as a base64-encoded string
Uses GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY from environment variables
Handles API errors gracefully
Typecheck passes
Build passes

userStories.title: Image generation API route
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a /api/generate endpoint that orchestrates the full image generation pipeline so that the frontend can trigger generation with one call.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/app/api/generate/route.ts as a POST endpoint
Accepts JSON body: { imageBase64: string, presetId: string }
Looks up the style preset by ID to get the prompt
Pipeline: (1) remove background via removebg.ts → (2) generate styled image via gemini.ts
Returns JSON: { generatedImage: string (base64), originalWithoutBg: string (base64) }
Returns appropriate error status codes (400 for bad input, 500 for pipeline failures)
Each pipeline step has try/catch with specific error messages so failures are debuggable
Typecheck passes
Build passes

userStories.title: Wire up image generation to the UI with reveal
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my generated cartoon sticker revealed in a satisfying before/after slider so that the transformation feels magical.
acceptanceCriteria: When user clicks 'Create My Sticker' in Step 2, call POST /api/generate with the captured image and selected preset ID
Show the LoadingState component while the API call is in progress

The slider shows the original photo on the left and the generated cartoon on the right
Below the reveal, show a 'Order Stickers' button to proceed to Step 3 and a 'Save Image' button to download the generated image
On API error, show an error message with a 'Try Again' button that returns to Step 2

userStories.title: Printful integration for sticker orders
userStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side functions to look up sticker products, estimate costs, and create orders via the Printful API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/printful.ts with these functions: getKissCutStickerVariants(), estimateOrderCost(variantId, quantity, imageUrl, address), createOrder(variantId, quantity, imageUrl, address, confirm)
getKissCutStickerVariants() queries GET /products to find kiss-cut sticker products and returns available variant IDs with their sizes and prices
estimateOrderCost() calls POST /orders/estimate-costs with the variant, quantity, image file URL, and recipient address
createOrder() calls POST /orders with confirm flag to submit the order for fulfillment
All functions use PRINTFUL_ACCESS_TOKEN and PRINTFUL_STORE_ID from environment variables
Auth header: Authorization: Bearer {token}, X-PF-Store-Id: {storeId}
Base URL: https://api.printful.com
Handle rate limits (120/min) and API errors gracefully
Typecheck passes
Build passes

userStories.title: Image storage for generated stickers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store generated sticker images at a public URL so that Printful can access them for printing.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/storage.ts with an uploadImage(imageBase64: string, filename: string) function

Use Vercel Blob (@vercel/blob) if BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN is set
If Blob token is not available, fall back to storing the base64 image in a local /tmp file and serving it via a simple API route (for development)
Create src/app/api/images/[id]/route.ts as the fallback serving endpoint that reads from /tmp
Update /api/generate to also store the generated image and return the public URL alongside the base64

userStories.title: Stripe payment integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need server-side Stripe integration to create payment intents and handle webhooks so that users can pay for their sticker orders.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/stripe.ts with: createPaymentIntent(amount, currency, metadata), verifyWebhookSignature(body, signature)

verifyWebhookSignature() verifies the Stripe webhook signature using STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET

userStories.title: Order and payment API routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API routes to create orders with cost estimation and handle Stripe payment confirmation to submit orders to Printful.
